scope: Fixed nine-turn learner script on seen UVa10041. Actual HTTP/CSRF, local model and Docker. Learner code authored beforehand; not evidence that a real student learned. No model outputs used for training.
acceptance: Every reply done/live; no unrequested full program; no critical mathematical or code diagnosis error; each turn self-review >=4/5. Review is not independent teacher assessment.

stages.expected_behavior: 承接中位數；選2或100或兩者間皆可，距離總和198，不能把平均數說成唯一最佳。
